title: Cryo-Electron Ptychography (Cryo-EPty) for Biological Imaging
content: Cryogenic transmission electron microscopy (cryo-EM) with single-particle analysis (SPA) is a powerful technique for resolving structure in three dimensions for a broad range of biological macromolecules at near-atomic resolution, providing visualization proof directly for function and mechanism research. Despite its revolutionary advances, cryo-EM, which is primarily based on conventional phase contrast TEM imaging at high defocus, still suffers from weak contrast and low signal to noise ratio with limited electron doses used to protect biomolecules from radiation damaging.
